policy.heading: Internal audit
policy.clause_text:
### H.1 Internal audit
A half-yearly internal audit report shall be submitted to the Stock Exchange
within the prescribed timeline.
policy.quote:
A half-yearly internal audit report shall be submitted to the Stock Exchange
within the prescribed timeline.

context.before: ### H.1 Internal audit

finding.rationale: The obligation requires intermediaries to file an annual system audit report, whereas the policy clause only specifies that an audit shall be conducted and the report placed before the Board; it does not mention filing the report to any regulatory body. Thus, the policy lacks the requirement to file the report and creates a gap.

policy.heading: System audit
policy.clause_text:
### H.4 System audit
An annual system audit shall be conducted by a CERT-In empanelled auditor and
the report placed before the Board.
policy.quote:
An annual system audit shall be conducted by a CERT-In empanelled auditor and
the report placed before the Board.

context.before: ### H.4 System audit

finding.rationale: The obligation mandates that any change in control be reported to SEBI within 7 days, while the policy clause requires such reporting within thirty (30) days. The clause covers the same scenario but provides a less stringent deadline, thus it does not satisfy the regulatory requirement and needs to be updated.
